about: Which configuration folder runs which tabs of the upload sheet (page/sheet_definition.json). page/workbook.py builds one request per record row and the page runs it through that folder's --run. A tab that is in no group here is reported as not set up yet. See the root CLAUDE.md > The upload sheet.

link.about: A purpose row belongs to the customer whose link_name (record tab: Name; First Name + space + Last Name) equals Customer Name, ignoring case and extra spaces. Names must be unique within one sheet (never assumed unique in Oracle).

address_pick.about: Bill-to Site is a list in Oracle holding only this customer's one address, shown on Ship to rows only. Empty = picked automatically; a typed value must match the text built from the record's address (case and extra spaces ignored).
